#Gamma(4,2): ALS and ALS* method
set.seed(101)
result_gamma42ALS=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma42lALS=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma42ALSb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma42lALSb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)

nv=c(30,50,75,100)
uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
cov_prob=rep(0,5)
for(k in 1:4) {
  for(j in 1:5) {
    count=0
    countb=0
    M=50000
    width=rep(0,M)
    widthb=rep(0,M)
    n=nv[k]
    usl=uslv[j]
    lsl=lslv[j]
    for(i in 1:M){
      
      s1a=(rgamma(n,4,2)+48)
      #sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
      md=mean(s1a)
      md2=median(s1a)
      
      sum=0   #LS
      sumb=0  # LS*
      for(m in 1:n){
        sum=sum+(s1a[m]-md)^2
        sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-md2)^2
      }
      sd1=sqrt(sum/(n-1))
      sd1b=sqrt(sumb/(n-1)) 
      
      sum4=0
      sum2=0
      sum4b=0
      sum2b=0
      xbar=mean(s1a)
      xbarb=median(s1a)
      for(m in 1:n) {
        sum2=sum2+(s1a[m]-xbar)^2
        sum4=sum4+(s1a[m]-xbar)^4
        sum2b=sum2+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^2
        sum4b=sum4b+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^4
      }
      
      m4=sum4/n
      m2=sum2/n
      m4b=sum4b/n
      m2b=sum2b/n
      
      g2=m4/(m2^2)-3
      G2=((n-1)*((n-1)*g2+6))/((n-2)*(n-3))
      ke5=((n+1)/(n-1))*G2*(1+5*G2/n)
      B=(ke5+2*n/(n-1))*(1+(ke5+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n))/n
      C=(ke5+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n)
      
      g2b=m4b/(m2b^2)-3
      G2b=((n-1)*((n-1)*g2b+6))/((n-2)*(n-3))
      ke5b=((n+1)/(n-1))*G2b*(1+5*G2b/n)
      Bb=(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))*(1+(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n))/n
      Cb=(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n)
      
      cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
      cp0b=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
      lcl=cp0/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(B)+C))
      ucl=cp0/sqrt(exp(-1.96*sqrt(B)+C))
      lclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(Bb)+Cb))
      uclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(-1.96*sqrt(Bb)+Cb))
      #lcl
      #ucl
      width[i]=ucl-lcl
      widthb[i]=uclb-lclb
      
      if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
      
      
      if(cpv[j]>lclb & cpv[j]<uclb) countb=countb+1
    }
    result_gamma42ALS[k,j]=count/M
    result_gamma42lALS[k,j]=mean(width)
    result_gamma42ALSb[k,j]=countb/M
    result_gamma42lALSb[k,j]=mean(widthb)
  }
}
result_gamma42ALS
result_gamma42ALSb
result_gamma42lALS
result_gamma42lALSb

  #Gamma(4,2): ADJ method and ADJ*
    set.seed(101)
    result_gamma42=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
    result_gamma42l=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
    result_gamma42b=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
    result_gamma42lb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
    
    nv=c(30,50,75,100)
    uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
    lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
    cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
    cov_prob=rep(0,5)
    for(k in 1:4) {
      for(j in 1:5) {
        count=0
        countb=0
        M=50000
        width=rep(0,M)
        widthb=rep(0,M)
        n=nv[k]
        usl=uslv[j]
        lsl=lslv[j]
        for(i in 1:M){s1a=(rgamma(n,4,2)+48)
        #sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
        md=mean(s1a)
        md2=median(s1a)
        
        sum=0   #ADJ
        sumb=0  # ADJ*
        for(m in 1:n){
          sum=sum+(s1a[m]-md)^2
          sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-md2)^2
        }
        sd1=sqrt(sum/(n-1))
        sd1b=sqrt(sumb/(n-1)) 
        
        s4=sd1^4
        s4b=sd1b^4
        
        sum=0
        sumb=0
        xbar=mean(s1a)
        xbarb=median(s1a)
        for(m in 1:n){
          sum=sum+(s1a[m]-xbar)^4
          sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^4
        }
        
        gamma_hat=(n*(n+1)/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)))*(sum/s4)-3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
        r_hat=(2*n)/(gamma_hat+2*n/(n-1))
        
        gamma_hatb=(n*(n+1)/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)))*(sumb/s4b)-3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
        r_hatb=(2*n)/(gamma_hatb+2*n/(n-1))
        
        cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1)
        cp0b=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
        lcl=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,r_hat)/r_hat)
        ucl=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,r_hat)/r_hat)
        lclb=cp0b*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,r_hatb)/r_hatb)
        uclb=cp0b*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,r_hatb)/r_hatb)
        
        width[i]=ucl-lcl
        widthb[i]=uclb-lclb
        
        #lcl
        #ucl
        width[i]=ucl-lcl
        
        if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
        if(cpv[j]>lclb & cpv[j]<uclb) countb=countb+1
        }
        
        result_gamma42[k,j]=count/M
        result_gamma42l[k,j]=mean(width)
        result_gamma42b[k,j]=countb/M
        result_gamma42lb[k,j]=mean(widthb)
      }
    }
    result_gamma42
    result_gamma42b
    result_gamma42l
    result_gamma42lb
    #Gamma(4,2): exact and truncate method
    set.seed(101)
    result_gamma42trunc=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma42ltrunc=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
    result_gamma42exact=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
    result_gamma42lexact=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
    
    nv=c(30,50,75,100)
    uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
    lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
    cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
    cov_prob=rep(0,5)
    p=0.1
    for(k in 1:4) {
      for(j in 1:5) {
        count=0
        count0=0
        M=50000
        width=rep(0,M)
        width0=rep(0,M)
        n=nv[k]
        usl=uslv[j]
        lsl=lslv[j]
        for(i in 1:M){
          #s1a=(rgamma(n,4,2)+48)
         
          
          s1a=sort(rgamma(n,4,2)+48)
          sd1=1.4826*sqrt(var(s1a[(trunc(n*p)+1):(n-trunc(n*p))]))
          sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
          cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd0)
          lcl0=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
          ucl0=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
          
          cp1=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1)
          lcl=cp1*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
          ucl=cp1*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
          #lcl
          
          #ucl
          width0[i]=ucl0-lcl0
          width[i]=ucl-lcl
          
          if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
          
          if(cpv[j]>lcl0 & cpv[j]<ucl0) count0=count0+1
        }
        
        
        result_gamma42exact[k,j]=count0/M
        result_gamma42lexact[k,j]=mean(width0)
        result_gamma42trunc[k,j]=count/M
        result_gamma42ltrunc[k,j]=mean(width)
        
      }
    }
    result_gamma42exact
    result_gamma42lexact
    result_gamma42trunc
   result_gamma42ltrunc

for(k in 1:4) {
  for(j in 1:5) {
    count=0

    widthb=rep(0,M)

    usl=uslv[j]
    lsl=lslv[j]

      #sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
      md=mean(s1a)
      md2=median(s1a)
      
      sum=0   #LS
      sumb=0  # LS*
      for(m in 1:n){
        sum=sum+(s1a[m]-md)^2
        sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-md2)^2
      }

      sd1b=sqrt(sumb/(n-1))

      cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1)

      lcl=cp0/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(A)))

      lclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(Ab)))
      uclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(-1.96*sqrt(Ab)))
      #lcl
      #ucl
      width[i]=ucl-lcl
      widthb[i]=uclb-lclb
      
      if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1

    }

set.seed(101)
result_N501=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_N501l=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_N501b=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_N501lb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)

nv=c(30,50,75,100)
uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
cov_prob=rep(0,5)
for(k in 1:4) {
  for(j in 1:5) {
    count=0
    countb=0
    M=50000
    width=rep(0,M)
    widthb=rep(0,M)
    n=nv[k]
    usl=uslv[j]
    lsl=lslv[j]
    for(i in 1:M){
      s1a=rnorm(n,50,1)
    #sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
    md=mean(s1a)
    md2=median(s1a)
    
    sum=0   #ADJ
    sumb=0  # ADJ*
    for(m in 1:n){
      sum=sum+(s1a[m]-md)^2
      sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-md2)^2
    }
    sd1=sqrt(sum/(n-1))
    sd1b=sqrt(sumb/(n-1)) 
    
    s4=sd1^4
    s4b=sd1b^4
    
    sum=0
    sumb=0
    xbar=mean(s1a)
    xbarb=median(s1a)
    for(m in 1:n){
      sum=sum+(s1a[m]-xbar)^4
      sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^4
    }
    
    gamma_hat=(n*(n+1)/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)))*(sum/s4)-3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
    r_hat=(2*n)/(gamma_hat+2*n/(n-1))
    
    gamma_hatb=(n*(n+1)/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)))*(sumb/s4b)-3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
    r_hatb=(2*n)/(gamma_hatb+2*n/(n-1))
    
    cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1)
    cp0b=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
    lcl=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,r_hat)/r_hat)
    ucl=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,r_hat)/r_hat)
    lclb=cp0b*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,r_hatb)/r_hatb)
    uclb=cp0b*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,r_hatb)/r_hatb)
    
    width[i]=ucl-lcl
    widthb[i]=uclb-lclb
    
    #lcl
    #ucl
    width[i]=ucl-lcl
    
    if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
    if(cpv[j]>lclb & cpv[j]<uclb) countb=countb+1
    }
    
    result_N501[k,j]=count/M
    result_N501l[k,j]=mean(width)
    result_N501b[k,j]=countb/M
    result_N501lb[k,j]=mean(widthb)
  }
}

#Gamma(0.75,0.867): ALS and ALS* method
set.seed(101)
result_gamma075ALS=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma075lALS=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma075ALSb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma075lALSb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)

nv=c(30,50,75,100)
uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
cov_prob=rep(0,5)
for(k in 1:4) {
  for(j in 1:5) {
    count=0
    countb=0
    M=50000
    width=rep(0,M)
    widthb=rep(0,M)
    n=nv[k]
    usl=uslv[j]
    lsl=lslv[j]
    for(i in 1:M){
      
      s1a=(rgamma(n,0.75,0.867)+49.1340)
      #sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
      md=mean(s1a)
      md2=median(s1a)
      
      sum=0   #LS
      sumb=0  # LS*
      for(m in 1:n){
        sum=sum+(s1a[m]-md)^2
        sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-md2)^2
      }
      sd1=sqrt(sum/(n-1))
      sd1b=sqrt(sumb/(n-1)) 
      
      sum4=0
      sum2=0
      sum4b=0
      sum2b=0
      xbar=mean(s1a)
      xbarb=median(s1a)
      for(m in 1:n) {
        sum2=sum2+(s1a[m]-xbar)^2
        sum4=sum4+(s1a[m]-xbar)^4
        sum2b=sum2+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^2
        sum4b=sum4b+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^4
      }
      
      m4=sum4/n
      m2=sum2/n
      m4b=sum4b/n
      m2b=sum2b/n
      
      g2=m4/(m2^2)-3
      G2=((n-1)*((n-1)*g2+6))/((n-2)*(n-3))
      ke5=((n+1)/(n-1))*G2*(1+5*G2/n)
      B=(ke5+2*n/(n-1))*(1+(ke5+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n))/n
      C=(ke5+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n)
      
      g2b=m4b/(m2b^2)-3
      G2b=((n-1)*((n-1)*g2b+6))/((n-2)*(n-3))
      ke5b=((n+1)/(n-1))*G2b*(1+5*G2b/n)
      Bb=(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))*(1+(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n))/n
      Cb=(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n)
      
      cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
      cp0b=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
      lcl=cp0/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(B)+C))
      ucl=cp0/sqrt(exp(-1.96*sqrt(B)+C))
      lclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(Bb)+Cb))
      uclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(-1.96*sqrt(Bb)+Cb))
      #lcl
      #ucl
      width[i]=ucl-lcl
      widthb[i]=uclb-lclb
      
      if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
      
      
      if(cpv[j]>lclb & cpv[j]<uclb) countb=countb+1
    }
    result_gamma075ALS[k,j]=count/M
    result_gamma075lALS[k,j]=mean(width)
    result_gamma075ALSb[k,j]=countb/M
    result_gamma075lALSb[k,j]=mean(widthb)
  }
}

#Gamma(0.25,0.5): ALS and ALS* method
set.seed(101)
result_gamma025ALS=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma025lALS=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma025ALSb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma025lALSb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)

nv=c(30,50,75,100)
uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
cov_prob=rep(0,5)
for(k in 1:4) {
  for(j in 1:5) {
    count=0
    countb=0
    M=50000
    width=rep(0,M)
    widthb=rep(0,M)
    n=nv[k]
    usl=uslv[j]
    lsl=lslv[j]
    for(i in 1:M){
      
      s1a=(rgamma(n,0.25,0.5)+49.5)
      #sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
      md=mean(s1a)
      md2=median(s1a)
      
      sum=0   #LS
      sumb=0  # LS*
      for(m in 1:n){
        sum=sum+(s1a[m]-md)^2
        sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-md2)^2
      }
      sd1=sqrt(sum/(n-1))
      sd1b=sqrt(sumb/(n-1)) 
      
      sum4=0
      sum2=0
      sum4b=0
      sum2b=0
      xbar=mean(s1a)
      xbarb=median(s1a)
      for(m in 1:n) {
        sum2=sum2+(s1a[m]-xbar)^2
        sum4=sum4+(s1a[m]-xbar)^4
        sum2b=sum2+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^2
        sum4b=sum4b+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^4
      }
      
      m4=sum4/n
      m2=sum2/n
      m4b=sum4b/n
      m2b=sum2b/n
      
      g2=m4/(m2^2)-3
      G2=((n-1)*((n-1)*g2+6))/((n-2)*(n-3))
      ke5=((n+1)/(n-1))*G2*(1+5*G2/n)
      B=(ke5+2*n/(n-1))*(1+(ke5+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n))/n
      C=(ke5+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n)
      
      g2b=m4b/(m2b^2)-3
      G2b=((n-1)*((n-1)*g2b+6))/((n-2)*(n-3))
      ke5b=((n+1)/(n-1))*G2b*(1+5*G2b/n)
      Bb=(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))*(1+(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n))/n
      Cb=(ke5b+2*n/(n-1))/(2*n)
      
      cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1)
      cp0b=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
      lcl=cp0/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(B)+C))
      ucl=cp0/sqrt(exp(-1.96*sqrt(B)+C))
      lclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(1.96*sqrt(Bb)+Cb))
      uclb=cp0b/sqrt(exp(-1.96*sqrt(Bb)+Cb))
      #lcl
      #ucl
      width[i]=ucl-lcl
      widthb[i]=uclb-lclb
      
      if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
      
      
      if(cpv[j]>lclb & cpv[j]<uclb) countb=countb+1
    }
    result_gamma025ALS[k,j]=count/M
    result_gamma025lALS[k,j]=mean(width)
    result_gamma025ALSb[k,j]=countb/M
    result_gamma025lALSb[k,j]=mean(widthb)
    
  }
}
result_gamma025ALS
result_gamma025ALSb
result_gamma025lALS
result_gamma025lALSb

#Gamma((0.25,0.5): ADJ method and ADJ*
set.seed(101)
result_gamma025=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma025l=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma025b=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma025lb=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)

nv=c(30,50,75,100)
uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
cov_prob=rep(0,5)
for(k in 1:4) {
  for(j in 1:5) {
    count=0
    countb=0
    M=50000
    width=rep(0,M)
    widthb=rep(0,M)
    n=nv[k]
    usl=uslv[j]
    lsl=lslv[j]
    for(i in 1:M){
      
    s1a=(rgamma(n,0.25,0.5)+49.5)
    #sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
    md=mean(s1a)
    md2=median(s1a)
    
    sum=0   #ADJ
    sumb=0  # ADJ*
    for(m in 1:n){
      sum=sum+(s1a[m]-md)^2
      sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-md2)^2
    }
    sd1=sqrt(sum/(n-1))
    sd1b=sqrt(sumb/(n-1)) 
    
    s4=sd1^4
    s4b=sd1b^4
    
    sum=0
    sumb=0
    xbar=mean(s1a)
    xbarb=median(s1a)
    for(m in 1:n){
      sum=sum+(s1a[m]-xbar)^4
      sumb=sumb+(s1a[m]-xbarb)^4
    }
    
    gamma_hat=(n*(n+1)/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)))*(sum/s4)-3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
    r_hat=(2*n)/(gamma_hat+2*n/(n-1))
    
    gamma_hatb=(n*(n+1)/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)))*(sumb/s4b)-3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3))
    r_hatb=(2*n)/(gamma_hatb+2*n/(n-1))
    
    cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1)
    cp0b=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1b)
    lcl=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,r_hat)/r_hat)
    ucl=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,r_hat)/r_hat)
    lclb=cp0b*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,r_hatb)/r_hatb)
    uclb=cp0b*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,r_hatb)/r_hatb)
    
    width[i]=ucl-lcl
    widthb[i]=uclb-lclb
    
    #lcl
    #ucl
    width[i]=ucl-lcl
    
    if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
    if(cpv[j]>lclb & cpv[j]<uclb) countb=countb+1
    }
    
    result_gamma025[k,j]=count/M
    result_gamma025l[k,j]=mean(width)
    result_gamma025b[k,j]=countb/M
    result_gamma025lb[k,j]=mean(widthb)
  }
}
result_gamma025
result_gamma025b
result_gamma025l
result_gamma025lb

set.seed(101)
result_gamma025trunc=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)
result_gamma025ltrunc=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)

result_gamma025lexact=matrix(rep(0,4*5),4,5)

nv=c(30,50,75,100)
uslv=c(53,53.99,54.50,55.01,56)
lslv=c(47,46.01,45.50,44.99,44)
cpv=c(1,1.33,1.5,1.67,2)
cov_prob=rep(0,5)
p=0.1
for(k in 1:4) {
  for(j in 1:5) {
    count=0
    count0=0
    M=50000
    width=rep(0,M)
    width0=rep(0,M)
    n=nv[k]
    usl=uslv[j]
    lsl=lslv[j]
    for(i in 1:M){
      #s1a=(rgamma(n,4,2)+48)
      
      s1a=sort(rgamma(n,0.25,0.5)+49.5)
      sd0=sqrt(var(s1a))
      sd1=1.4826*sqrt(var(s1a[(trunc(n*p)+1):(n-trunc(n*p))]))
      
      cp0=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd0)
      lcl0=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
      ucl0=cp0*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
      
      cp1=(usl-lsl)/(6*sd1)
      lcl=cp1*sqrt(qchisq(0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
      ucl=cp1*sqrt(qchisq(1-0.025,n-1)/(n-1))
      #lcl
      
      #ucl
      width0[i]=ucl0-lcl0
      width[i]=ucl-lcl
      
      if(cpv[j]>lcl & cpv[j]<ucl) count=count+1
      
      if(cpv[j]>lcl0 & cpv[j]<ucl0) count0=count0+1
    }
    
    
    result_gamma025exact[k,j]=count0/M
    result_gamma025lexact[k,j]=mean(width0)
    result_gamma025trunc[k,j]=count/M
    result_gamma025ltrunc[k,j]=mean(width)
    
  }
}
